1	# =============================================================================
2	# Paperclip — Cloudflare Workers deployment configuration
3	#
4	# After running `wrangler deploy` for the first time, fill in the placeholder
5	# IDs that Cloudflare generates (search for "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY").
6	#
7	# Quick start:
8	#   1. wrangler deploy
9	#   2. wrangler hyperdrive create paperclip-hyperdrive --connection-string="<neon-url>"
10	#      Then paste the returned ID into [hyperdrive] binding below.
11	#   3. Open https://<your-worker>.workers.dev/setup to complete first-run setup.
12	# =============================================================================
13	
14	name = "paperclip-api"
15	compatibility_date = "2025-03-01"
16	compatibility_flags = ["nodejs_compat"]
17	main = "dist/worker.js"
18	
19	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
20	# Static assets — serves the React UI build from ui/dist alongside the Worker.
21	# not_found_handling = "single-page-application" makes CF serve index.html for
22	# any path that doesn't match a static file (needed for client-side routing).
23	# The Worker gets an ASSETS Fetcher binding to delegate non-API requests.
24	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
25	[assets]
26	directory = "../../ui/dist"
27	binding = "ASSETS"
28	not_found_handling = "single-page-application"
29	
30	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
31	# Local dev settings
32	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
33	[dev]
34	# Containers require Docker; disable in local dev so wrangler dev starts without it.
35	# The SidecarContainer / PluginContainer DOs fall back to SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL from KV.
36	enable_containers = false
37	
38	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
39	# Variables (non-secret; override secrets via `wrangler secret put`)
40	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
41	[vars]
42	DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORM = "cloudflare"
43	DEPLOYMENT_MODE = "authenticated"
44	DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE = "public"
45	
46	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
47	# R2 object storage — artifacts, skill bundles, attachments, DB backups
48	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
49	[[r2_buckets]]
50	binding = "PAPERCLIP_STORAGE"
51	bucket_name = "paperclip-storage"
52	# preview_bucket_name = "paperclip-storage-preview"
53	
54	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
55	# KV — sessions cache, hot config, first-run setup flag
56	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
57	[[kv_namespaces]]
58	binding = "PAPERCLIP_KV"
59	id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY"
60	# preview_id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY_PREVIEW"
61	
62	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
63	# Hyperdrive — Phase 1: wraps Neon/Postgres for low-latency DB access
64	# After deploying: wrangler hyperdrive create paperclip-hyperdrive --connection-string="<neon-url>"
65	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
66	[[hyperdrive]]
67	binding = "HYPERDRIVE"
68	id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY"
69	localConnectionString = "postgres://paperclip:paperclip@127.0.0.1:54329/paperclip"
70	
71	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
72	# Queues — background fanout (cost rollups, activity log flush, plugin jobs)
73	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
74	[[queues.producers]]
75	binding = "PAPERCLIP_QUEUE"
76	queue = "paperclip-jobs"
77	
78	[[queues.consumers]]
79	queue = "paperclip-jobs"
80	max_batch_size = 10
81	max_batch_timeout = 5
82	max_retries = 3
83	dead_letter_queue = "paperclip-jobs-dlq"
84	
85	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
86	# Durable Objects — per-task state, per-agent-run state, scheduler alarms
87	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
88	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
89	name = "TASK_DO"
90	class_name = "TaskDO"
91	
92	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
93	name = "AGENT_RUN_DO"
94	class_name = "AgentRunDO"
95	
96	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
97	name = "SCHEDULER_DO"
98	class_name = "SchedulerDO"
99	
100	# Container DO bindings — each wraps a CF Container (Docker image).
101	# The DO proxies HTTP to the container via getTcpPort(); falls back to
102	# SANDBOX_BRIDGE_URL from KV when running locally without Docker.
103	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
104	name = "SIDECAR_SERVICE"
105	class_name = "SidecarContainer"
106	
107	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
108	name = "PLUGIN_CONTAINER"
109	class_name = "PluginContainer"
110	
111	# DO migrations — bump new_classes when adding a new DO class
112	[[migrations]]
113	tag = "v1"
114	new_classes = ["TaskDO", "AgentRunDO", "SchedulerDO"]
115	
116	[[migrations]]
117	tag = "v2"
118	new_classes = ["SidecarContainer", "PluginContainer"]
119	
120	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
121	# Workflows — checkpointed multi-step agent execution
122	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
123	[[workflows]]
124	binding = "HEARTBEAT_WORKFLOW"
125	name = "heartbeat-workflow"
126	class_name = "HeartbeatWorkflow"
127	script_name = "paperclip-api"
128	
129	[[workflows]]
130	binding = "PLUGIN_DISPATCH_WORKFLOW"
131	name = "plugin-dispatch-workflow"
132	class_name = "PluginDispatchWorkflow"
133	script_name = "paperclip-api"
134	
135	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
136	# Cron triggers — fire heartbeat sweep, budget checks, DB backup
137	# Adjust intervals to taste; avoid high-frequency triggers (see CLOUDFLARE.md §10)
138	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
139	[triggers]
140	crons = [
141	  "*/5 * * * *",   # heartbeat sweep every 5 minutes
142	  "0 * * * *",     # budget threshold check every hour
143	  "0 3 * * *",     # DB backup daily at 03:00 UTC
144	]
145	
146	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
147	# Cloudflare Containers — run execution services natively on Cloudflare.
148	#
149	# CF Containers (beta) let Workers communicate with Docker containers via
150	# a Fetcher service binding. No external servers needed.
151	#
152	# Required secrets (set via `wrangler secret put`):
153	#   - none for containers (authentication is implicit via the binding)
154	#
155	# For external sidecar fallback (optional, for non-CF deployments):
156	#   wrangler secret put SIDECAR_URL
157	#   wrangler secret put SIDECAR_API_KEY
158	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
159	
160	# Sidecar — companion Node.js server for agent heartbeat execution, plugin job
161	# lifecycle (claim/execute/complete), filesystem and git operations.
162	# The SidecarContainer DO class wraps this image (see src/worker/containers.ts).
163	[[containers]]
164	class_name = "SidecarContainer"
165	image = "ghcr.io/paperclipai/paperclip-sidecar:latest"
166	
167	# Plugin sandbox — isolated command execution environment for adapter plugins.
168	# Exposes POST /execute and POST /cancel/:runId.
169	[[containers]]
170	class_name = "PluginContainer"
171	image = "ghcr.io/paperclipai/plugin-sandbox:latest"
172
